method: Polygonize original JRC class 2 native cells within frozen zone_KMZ pixel-center mask. Exact native pixel edges, no smoothing or morphological fill. Not clipped to vector boundary, so geometry matches the frozen area mask. Differential class change only on cells valid in both months. weights_ha from frozen NPZ.
warning: 1984–2024为产品月份槽；合格几何实际仅1985–2024共72月。2000–2024暖季主样本59个月精确保留，2008/2010争议不静默剔除。2025/2026无JRC同期边界，不得以2024替代。无水几何不是干湖判定。

field_dictionary.date: lake_quality.csv year_month, JRC monthly composite not individual acquisition
field_dictionary.classification_disputed: year 2008 or 2010, frozen sensitivity label retained independent of eligibility
field_dictionary.water_geojson: original class 2 cells within zone_KMZ center-mask
field_dictionary.nodata_geojson: original class 0 cells within zone_KMZ center-mask
field_dictionary.shoreline_geojson: boundary of water-class cell polygon (includes holes), not surveyed shoreline
field_dictionary.areas.gain: weights_ha sum on A=1,B=2 and zone_KMZ
field_dictionary.areas.loss: weights_ha sum on A=2,B=1 and zone_KMZ
field_dictionary.areas.overlap: weights_ha sum on A=2,B=2 and zone_KMZ
field_dictionary.common_valid_ha: weights_ha sum on A>0,B>0 and zone_KMZ
field_dictionary.excluded_unknown_ha: weights_ha sum on either date class 0 and zone_KMZ
